entries.clue: Magnetised needle swinging in its dial, settling on north to fix a walker's bearing
Wedge-bladed tool swung two-handed to split logs
Piratical brown seabird that harries others for their catch at both poles
Skiing pioneer of the great northern drift, later a Nobel peace laureate
Drifting slab of frozen sea a beset ship may be pinned among
Scans the pool from a high chair, whistle ready and float within reach
Cuts and beds stone, tapping each course true against a taut line
Runnered load-carrier hauled by dog teams or by men in harness
Glass-sided glow you hang from a ridgepole once dusk falls
Hidden split in a glacier, bridged over by treacherous drifted snow
Round felt-walled dwelling of the steppe, now a glamping treat
Orange coal still breathing in the ash after the flames drop
Checks the chart, changes the drip and works the night shift on the ward
